stages.name: Define
stages.scope: Product identity, audience, capabilities, and boundaries.

stages.name: Establish
stages.scope: Brand, website, company foundations, and Cloudflare strategy.

stages.name: Build
stages.scope: Cloud storage, authentication, preservation, organization, search, and reliability.

stages.name: Extend
stages.scope: Sharing, annotations, and richer reference workflows.

stages.name: Explore
stages.scope: Intelligent organization, guest feedback, and future capabilities.

items.title: Write down the Source of Truth
items.summary: One authoritative statement of the product definition, principle, commitments, structure, and planning stages.

items.title: Define the audience
items.summary: Who Good Internet is for. The stage names audience as part of Define; it has not been written down yet.

items.title: Write the capability list and the boundaries
items.summary: What the product does, and what it deliberately does not: no general knowledge management (6), no native iOS or macOS apps (10). Starts from the commitments; adds nothing to them without sign-off.

items.title: Settle the visual identity
items.summary: The brand look is still open. This is the design work that comes after the foundation is reconciled.

items.title: Public website: the words, then the page
items.summary: Identity, product introduction, principles, roadmap, and updates. A rebuilt site exists on the marketing-rebuild branch. Next step is the hero copy.
items.notes: Nothing on the site may present planned work as available (commitment 11).

items.title: Keep the public roadmap and status honest
items.summary: The public roadmap page and any status claims must match docs/roadmap/roadmap.json. Anything not built is labeled as not built.
doneWhen: Public roadmap reads from, or is checked against, this roadmap
No page implies storage, backup, sharing, or AI exists before it ships

items.title: Company foundations
items.summary: Named in the Establish stage. Scope is not yet defined.

items.title: Cloudflare strategy
items.summary: The Cloudflare for Startups application is pending. Acceptance is not assumed. Proposed priorities: original-file storage, image delivery and processing, intelligent reference organization.
items.notes: A strategy under consideration, not a selected provider. Good Internet development does not depend on the outcome: acceptance is not assumed and nothing in Build waits on it. See choices C-1, C-4.

items.title: Cloud storage for a user's references
items.summary: References live in the cloud, reachable from the browser, so they don't take up local device storage.
doneWhen: A user can add a reference and open it from a different device with nothing kept locally

items.title: Accounts, with libraries private by default
items.summary: Sign-in and a session. Every library is private unless its owner shares it. Access is enforced on the server, not only hidden in the UI.
doneWhen: A signed-out or different user cannot read a private library or its files
A new library is private without any setting being changed
items.notes: The prototype UI has invite-only access and a two-factor screen. Whether those are product requirements has not been decided.

items.title: Preserve originals and their metadata
items.summary: The uploaded file is stored as it arrived: same bytes, same metadata. It is never replaced by a compressed version.
doneWhen: The original downloaded later is byte-identical to the original uploaded

items.title: Optimized previews, kept separate from originals
items.summary: Previews are generated for fast display. They are derived copies that never overwrite or stand in for the original.
doneWhen: Deleting or regenerating a preview leaves the original untouched
items.notes: 'Previews are optimized' is part of the core product principle, so the requirement is stated. The 'done when' criterion (previews never overwrite originals) is a proposal for review.

items.title: Integrity checks
items.summary: Detect a stored original that no longer matches what was uploaded.
doneWhen: Each original has a recorded fingerprint taken at upload
Stored files are verified against it, and a mismatch is surfaced rather than ignored
items.notes: Named in commitment 5 as an engineering requirement. The 'done when' criteria are proposals for review.

items.title: Backups
items.summary: Originals and library data are backed up so one failure cannot lose them.
doneWhen: Backups run on a schedule and their success is checked
items.notes: Named in commitment 5 as an engineering requirement. The 'done when' criteria are proposals for review.

items.title: Recovery, tested
items.summary: A written and rehearsed way to restore from backup. A backup that has never been restored is not yet trusted.
doneWhen: A restore has been performed end to end from a backup, and the result verified against BLD-5
items.notes: Named in commitment 5 as an engineering requirement. The 'done when' criteria are proposals for review.

items.title: Export
items.summary: A user can take their references with them: originals and their organization, not only previews.
doneWhen: An export contains the original files, metadata, and collection/tag/note information

items.title: Organization: collections, tags, notes
items.summary: Collections, tags, and notes on stored references. The prototype UI has these on sample data.

items.title: Search
items.summary: Find stored references again. The prototype UI has a search on sample data.

items.title: Replace the prototype's sample data with the real thing
items.summary: The private workspace UI currently runs on mock data behind src/good-internet/repository.ts and session.ts. Real storage and accounts go behind those same functions. Until then the workspace is labeled a prototype.
items.notes: Depends on choices C-1 to C-3.

items.title: Share a collection by link
items.summary: Users selectively share collections through links without exposing the rest of their library.
doneWhen: A link shows only the chosen collection
Nothing else in the owner's library is reachable through it
items.notes: Ending a share is EXT-4. Sharing does not exist today; the prototype's share screens run on sample data.

items.title: Annotations
items.summary: Annotations on references, listed in commitment 7 and in the Extend stage. Guest annotations are separate and exploratory (XPL-2).

items.title: Richer reference workflows
items.summary: Named in the Extend stage. What 'richer' means has not been defined, and is not to be invented here.
items.notes: Undefined placeholder. It does not authorize any additional feature; defining one needs a separate decision.

items.title: Revoke shared access
items.summary: The owner can end a share so its link stops working. Required whenever link sharing is implemented, so that sharing stays intentional (8) and the library stays private (4). Applies only once EXT-1 exists.
doneWhen: After a share is revoked, its old link no longer shows the collection
Revoking one share leaves the owner's other shares and private library unaffected

items.title: Intelligent organization
items.summary: AI help with administrative work such as tagging and organizing. It assists and does not take control away from the user. Automatic AI tagging is not a locked requirement.

items.title: Guest feedback and annotations on shared collections
items.summary: Discussed, not locked.

items.title: File formats beyond images
items.summary: Discussed, not locked. The product is images today.

items.title: Advanced retrieval
items.summary: Discussed, not locked. Basic search is BLD-10.

choices.title: Where original files are stored
choices.note: Cloudflare is under consideration (EST-5), but acceptance is not a dependency for development. No provider is selected.

choices.title: Backend and database platform
choices.note: Supabase was assumed by the archived October roadmap. It was never approved and is not ruled out.

choices.title: Authentication approach
choices.note: Includes whether the prototype's invite-only access and two-factor become requirements.

choices.title: Image processing and delivery
choices.note: Named as a proposed Cloudflare priority. Not selected, and not dependent on the application.

choices.title: How backup and recovery are done
AI provider and approach for assisted organization
Pricing and storage limits
choices.note: Exploratory per the Source of Truth. Not a roadmap item until decided.
